overview: 本期共收录 5 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（3 篇）、金融科技（1 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以倾向得分匹配、向量自回归为主。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。

papers.title: The Watchful Eye: Government Accounting Supervision and Its Effects on Supply Chain Finance
papers.abstract: This study investigates the impact of government accounting supervision on the adoption of supply chain finance (SCF) among Chinese listed firms. Using a difference‐in‐differences (DID) approach and a comprehensive dataset spanning 1999 to 2022, we find robust evidence that government accounting supervision significantly promotes the adoption of SCF. This relationship remains resilient across a battery of robustness checks, including parallel trend analysis, propensity score matching (PSM‐DID), placebo tests, and alternative sample specifications. Mechanism analysis reveals that the positive impact of government accounting supervision is primarily driven by enhanced supply chain transparency and the suppression of abnormal related‐party transactions. Furthermore, cross‐sectional analyses reveal that this effect is more pronounced in firms with higher supplier concentration or those lacking political connections. Overall, our findings offer important insights into the role of institutional oversight in fostering financial innovation and enhancing supply chain sustainability.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了政府会计监督对中国上市公司采用供应链金融（SCF）行为的影响。通过运用差异-in-differences（DID）方法，并结合1999年至2022年的综合数据集，我们获得了强有力的证据，表明政府会计监督显著促进了供应链金融的采纳。这一关系在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立，包括平行趋势分析、倾向得分匹配（PSM-DID）检验、安慰剂检验以及不同的样本设定。机制分析显示，政府会计监督的积极效应主要源于提升了供应链透明度以及遏制了异常关联方交易。此外，横截面分析表明，这种效应在供应商集中度较高或缺乏政治关系的企业中更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究结果为理解制度监督在推动金融创新和增强供应链可持续性方面的作用提供了重要启示。。研究方法：倾向得分匹配。

papers.title: Rethinking digital finance: the interplay of inclusion and corruption control
papers.abstract: Digital financial inclusion (DFI) is increasingly viewed as a potential governance-enhancing tool because digital transactions can improve traceability, reduce cash-based discretion, and expand participation in formal financial systems. Yet its anti-corruption effect is not automatic; rapid digital expansion may also create regulatory gaps, fraud, and opportunities for rent extraction where legal institutions are weak. This paper examines the dynamic andnonlinear relationship between DFI and corruption control and how it is conditioned by rule of law. Drawing on an unbalanced panel of 136 countries over 2004–2024, we construct a multidimensional DFI index from access, usage, and adoption indicators through multiple imputation, standardization, and principal component analysis. The empirical strategy combines panel vector autoregression (PVAR) for dynamic analysis with two-step System GMM for estimating nonlinear and institutionally conditional relationships. The PVAR results show that changes in DFI and, more strongly, changes in the DFI–rule-of-law interaction predict subsequent changes in corruption control, while reverse predictability from corruption control to DFI is limited. The System GMM estimates show that DFI alone does not automatically improve corruption control. However, when the interaction with rule of law is introduced, the squared DFI term becomes positive and the DFI–rule-of-law interaction is also positive, indicating that the marginal effect of DFI becomes governance-enhancing when it reaches sufficient scale and operates within credible rule-of-law institutions. Income-group analysis further shows that DFI becomes favorable at lower levels of adoption in middle- and high-income countries than in low-income countries. Robustness checks using the Corruption Perceptions Index confirm the central findings. Overall, DFI is not a stand-alone anti-corruption instrument; it becomes effective only when it reaches sufficient scale and is embedded in credible rule-of-law institutions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】数字金融包容性（Digital Financial Inclusion，DFI）日益被视为一种能够提升治理效率的工具，因为数字交易能够提高交易透明度、减少对现金的依赖，并促进更多人参与正式金融体系。然而，其反腐败效果并非自然而然地产生；快速的数字化进程也可能在法律制度薄弱的情况下引发监管漏洞、欺诈行为以及租金剥削现象。本文探讨了DFI与腐败控制之间的动态非线性关系，以及这种关系如何受到法治环境的制约。基于2004至2024年间136个国家的非平衡面板数据，我们通过多重插补、标准化和主成分分析方法构建了一个多维度的DFI指数，该指数涵盖了数字金融的接入性、使用率和采纳程度等指标。实证研究采用了面板向量自回归（Panel Vector Autoregression，PVAR）模型进行动态分析，并结合两步系统广义矩估计（System GMM）模型来评估非线性关系及制度条件对DFI与腐败控制之间关系的影响。PVAR分析结果表明，DFI的变化，尤其是DFI与法治环境之间的相互作用变化，能够预测后续的腐败控制状况；而反向的预测能力（即从腐败控制状况推断DFI变化的能力）则较为有限。系统广义矩...。研究方法：向量自回归、回归分析、广义矩估计、主成分分析。

papers.title: Measuring Crypto Tail Risk under Extreme Shocks: An EVT-GARCH and CAViaR Comparative Study
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Cryptocurrency markets face frequent extreme price swings, flash crashes and liquidity shocks. The expansion of decentralized finance, stablecoins and interconnected trading venues further complicates tail-risk measurement. This study examines extreme downside risk in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Uniswap, and DAI, treating the 2022 FTX collapse as the primary exogenous shock event. Daily closing prices from the Kaggle dataset are aligned by calendar date and transformed into logarithmic returns. Descriptive statistics and Jarque-Bera tests are first conducted, followed by an EVT-GARCH model incorporating an FTX event dummy and an Asymmetric Slope CAViaR model for tail-risk estimation. The results reveal significant deviations from normality, heavy tails, and substantial differences across asset types. The FTX window is associated with additional volatility in all four assets, including de-pegging-related risk in DAI. Backtesting at the 99% and 95% VaR levels indicates that both models provide reliable risk forecasts. EVT-GARCH generates smoother risk estimates, while CAViaR responds more quickly to recent negative shocks and records smaller violation-count deviations for the benchmark assets. These findings support the joint use of complementary models in cryptocurrency stress testing and risk monitoring.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】加密货币市场经常面临极端的价格波动、突发性暴跌和流动性冲击。去中心化金融（DeFi）的快速发展、稳定币（stablecoins）以及相互连接的交易平台进一步增加了尾部风险（tail-risk）的测量难度。本研究重点分析了比特币（Bitcoin）、以太坊（Ethereum）、Uniswap和DAI的极端下行风险，以2022年FTX交易所的倒闭事件作为主要的外生冲击事件。研究使用了Kaggle数据集中的每日收盘价，按照日历日期对数据进行对齐，并将其转换为对数收益率。首先进行了描述性统计分析和Jarque-Bera检验，随后采用了包含FTX事件虚拟变量（dummy variable）的EVT-GARCH模型以及非对称斜率CAViaR模型来进行尾部风险估计。研究结果表明，这些资产的价格分布显著偏离正态分布，具有厚尾特性，并且不同资产之间的尾部风险存在显著差异。FTX事件期间，所有四种资产的波动性均有所增加，尤其是DAI因与美元脱钩而面临额外风险。在99%和95%的VaR（Value at Risk）水平下进行的回测显示，这两种模型都能提供可靠的风险预测结果：EVT-GARCH模型生成的风...。研究方法：GARCH 波动率模型。

papers.title: Budget federalism as a mechanism for equalizing the provision of merit goods to the regions
papers.abstract:
Aim.
 To substantiate budget federalism measures aimed at equalizing the provision of merit goods to the population of regions, and to demonstrate the need for a transition from assessing budget capacity to assessing the accessibility of socially significant goods.
 Objectives.
 To characterize the forms of federal intergovernmental transfers and their significance for financing merit goods; to analyze the dynamics and functional structure of federal intergovernmental transfers in 2023–2025; to propose a typology of regions by dominant problems in the provision of merit goods to the population and to calculate the average grant dependency index for the identified types.
 Methods.
 The research employs methods of systemic, comparative, and structural analysis, a typologization method, and a calculation method. The information base consists of provisions of the budget legislation of Russia, data from the Ministry of Finance of Russia, the Federal Treasury, and scholarly publications devoted to issues of budget federalism, intergovernmental transfers, regional equalization, and social infrastructure.
 Results.
 It is established that in 2023–2025, the role of subsidies increased while the share of grants decreased in the structure of federal intergovernmental transfers, reflecting the growing importance of targeted program-project financing of the regions of Russia. A typology of regions of Russia is proposed depending on the dominant problems in the provision of merit goods to the population. The average grant dependency index is calculated taking into account the types of regions. It is shown that the highest formal degree of grant dependency is characteristic of regions with high vulnerability of families with children and regions with low population incomes.
 Conclusions.
 Budget federalism in the sphere of merit goods should be assessed not only by the volume of transfers and the level of grant dependency of regions but also by the ability of the instruments employed to reduce territorial disparities in the accessibility of education, healthcare, social protection, culture, and sports. Grants smooth out differences in budget capacity, but specific infrastructure and social deficits require a combination of grants, subsidies, subventions, other transfers, special standards, and intraregional redistribution. The results obtained in the study can be used in the formation of intergovernmental transfers taking into account dominant regional needs.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**目的**  
旨在验证旨在实现各地区民众均等获得公共产品的预算联邦主义措施的有效性，并阐明从评估政府预算能力向评估具有社会意义的产品可及性转变的必要性。  

**目标**  
1. 描述联邦政府间转移支付的形式及其对公共产品融资的重要性；  
2. 分析2023–2025年间联邦政府间转移支付的动态和功能结构；  
3. 根据各地区在提供公共产品方面面临的主要问题对区域进行分类，并计算各类区域的平均补助依赖指数。  

**方法**  
本研究采用了系统分析、比较分析、结构分析、分类方法以及计算方法。信息来源包括俄罗斯预算立法的规定、俄罗斯财政部和联邦财政部的数据，以及关于预算联邦主义、政府间转移支付、区域均衡和社会基础设施的学术文献。  

**结果**  
研究发现，在2023–2025年间，联邦政府间转移支付结构中补助的比例有所增加，而拨款的比例则有所下降，这反映了针对俄罗斯各地区的项目融资日益重要。根据各地区在提供公共产品方面面临的主要问题，提出了俄罗斯区域的分类方案。在计算平均补助依赖指数时考虑了不同类型的区域特征。结果表明，具有较高儿童家庭脆弱性和较低人均收入的...。

papers.title: The Role of the Cobit 2019 Framework in Achieving Audit Effectiveness in Light of the Electronic Transformation of Financial Activities
papers.venue: IIARD International Journal of Economics and Business Management
papers.abstract:
Abstract
The research aims to identify the role of internal control systems in light of the electronic
transformation of financial activities carried out by the economic unit, particularly governmental
ones, and the role of the Cobit 2019 framework in enhancing the efficiency of those control
procedures and bridging the gap arising from that transformation. The research problem focuses
on the requirements for using the 2019 COBIT framework in economic units in light of the
electronic transformation of activities and achieving the effectiveness of internal control over
them, the descriptive analytical method was relied upon to identify the research problem, as well
as the inductive method to study and clarify the role of internal control systems in facing the risks
of electronic transformation of financial activities. The research sample was selected from one of
the economic units in the Iraqi environment, funded by the Ministry of Finance. The research
reached several conclusions, the most notable of which is the existence of a gap in some electronic
financial activities that are not covered by regulatory procedures, creating opportunities that can
be exploited to establish fraudulent operations. In addition to the fact that the framework to create
fraudulent operations. Moreover, the 2019 COBIT framework contains a set of principles and
objectives that enhance control measures over the activities of economic units in light of the
electronic transformation of those activities. The research recommended the necessity of adopting
2019 COBIT in developing the internal control system and its activities on one hand, and the
governance of information technology on the other hand. In addition to bridging the gap resulting
from that transformation.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
本研究旨在探讨内部控制体系在电子化财务活动（尤其是政府部门的财务活动）中的作用，以及Cobit 2019框架在提升这些控制流程效率、弥补电子化转型所带来的差距方面的作用。研究重点关注经济单位在电子化转型背景下应用Cobit 2019框架的要求，以及如何确保内部控制的有效性。研究采用描述性分析方法来明确研究问题，并运用归纳法来分析内部控制体系在应对财务活动电子化转型所带来的风险中的作用。研究样本选自伊拉克境内一家由财政部资助的经济单位。研究得出若干结论：部分电子化财务活动缺乏相应的监管机制，这为欺诈行为提供了可乘之机；同时，Cobit 2019框架提供了一套原则与目标，有助于加强经济单位在电子化转型背景下的内部控制措施。研究建议在构建内部控制体系及开展相关活动时采纳Cobit 2019框架，并加强信息技术治理，以弥补电子化转型所带来的管理漏洞。。
